title: BYD is bringing its 5-min 'Flash' electric car charging to Canada
summary: BYD is expanding its revolutionary 'Flash' 5-minute ultra-fast charging technology to Canada, marking a significant milestone in EV infrastructure development that could eliminate range anxiety by making charging as quick as traditional refueling.
problem_solved: Solves the long charging time problem that has been a major barrier to EV adoption, reducing charging time to match traditional gasoline refueling.
why_valuable: 5-minute charging capability could be a game-changer for EV adoption, eliminating the biggest consumer concern about electric vehicles and making them truly competitive with combustion vehicles.
